title: Krishi Bhagya Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka

scheme_details.description: A scheme aimed at improving rainfed agriculture through efficient rainwater management, water conservation, improved farm productivity and dryland horticulture.
eligibility: Farmers meeting the applicable scheme and district guidelines

money_benefits.subsidy: Financial assistance for eligible scheme components, subject to the applicable government guidelines and beneficiary category.
money_benefits.micro_irrigation_support: Support for eligible drip and sprinkler irrigation components.
money_benefits.farm_pond_support: Assistance for eligible farm pond construction and lining components.
money_benefits.pump_set_support: Assistance for eligible diesel pump sets.
money_benefits.other_support: Potential support for protective shade-net structures around farm ponds, as described by the Agriculture Department.

scheme_details.water_irrigation_support: Farm ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene or alternative pond lining, diesel pump sets, drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation and shade-net structures around farm ponds.
application_process: Contact the nearest Raita Samparka Kendra.
Consult the local Agriculture Department office about the current Krishi Bhagya application notification.
Confirm eligible components, land requirements, subsidy rates and available funding.
Obtain the current application form and document checklist from the department.
Submit the application and supporting documents as instructed by the Agriculture Officer.
Complete any required land or site verification.
Receive assistance only after approval under the applicable scheme guidelines.
benefits: Improved water availability during dry periods
scheme_details.implemented_by: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
